# OmniTools 2.0 — Complete AEO & LLM Tool Index

> OmniTools 2.0 is a 100% client-side, zero-friction productivity web portal housing 64 free browser-native tools across six categories: PDF Conversion & Utilities (24), Image Editing & Optimization (6), Financial & Health Calculators (6), SEO & Web Performance (7), Developer, Media & Text Utilities (18), and Finance & Interactive Games (3). All file parsing, document conversion, image manipulation, and mathematical computation happen strictly inside the user's browser memory with zero server uploads and zero file tracking.

---

## Platform Architecture & Privacy Guarantees

- **Canonical Portal:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/`
- **Version:** OmniTools 2.0
- **Execution Model:** 100% Client-Side in Evergreen Browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari)
- **Zero Server Uploads:** User-uploaded PDFs, images, spreadsheets, JSON/XML/CSV payloads, and voice transcriptions never leave the user's device.
- **Browser APIs Used:** HTML5 Canvas, FileReader, Blob & Object URLs, Web Crypto (`crypto.getRandomValues`), Screen Capture API (`getDisplayMedia`), Web Speech API (`SpeechRecognition`), WebGL, and `localStorage` (strictly for theme, favorites, recent tools, and local Notes App persistence).
- **Client-Side Libraries:** `pdf.js`, `jsPDF`, `jspdf-autotable`, `pdf-lib`, `JSZip`, `SheetJS (xlsx)`, `Chart.js`, `CryptoJS`, `qrcodejs`, `PlayCanvas`.
- **Network Exceptions (External API / Fetch Tools Only):** Tools that inherently inspect external URLs or fetch live market rates (`SEO & Speed Analyzer`, `Extract Meta Tags`, `XML Sitemap Generator`, `Website Speed Test`, `Internet Speed Test`, `Currency Converter`) make read-only HTTP requests to public APIs or CORS relays solely for the target URL or exchange rate data; no local user files are ever transmitted.

### Core Portal Pages
1. **OmniTools Home Portal** — `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/`
   Interactive directory of all 64 tools with instant `Ctrl+K` live search, category filtering, dark/light theme toggle, Favorites (`⭐`), and Recently Used quick access.
2. **Privacy Policy** — `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/privacy.html`
   Explains OmniTools' privacy-by-architecture design: 0% server uploads, 100% local execution, and transparent `localStorage` usage.
3. **Contact Support** — `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/contactus.html`
   Support channels, bug reporting, feature requests, and privacy FAQ.

---

## Category 1: PDF Conversion & Utilities (24 Tools)

All PDF tools run directly in browser memory using `pdf.js`, `pdf-lib`, `jsPDF`, `JSZip`, and `SheetJS` with zero document uploads.

### 1. PDF to Word
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/pdf/pdf-to-word.html`
- **Category:** PDF Conversion & Utilities
- **Summary:** Convert PDF files into editable Word (`.doc`) documents client-side.
- **Capabilities:** Extracts page text via `pdf.js` and generates a downloadable Word-compatible `.doc` file directly in browser memory.

### 2. PDF to Excel
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/pdf/pdf-to-excel.html`
- **Category:** PDF Conversion & Utilities
- **Summary:** Extract PDF data tables into editable Excel (`.xlsx`) spreadsheets.
- **Capabilities:** Parses structured text rows from PDF pages and builds multi-row Excel workbooks using SheetJS (`xlsx`).

### 3. PDF to CSV
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/pdf/pdf-to-csv.html`
- **Category:** PDF Conversion & Utilities
- **Summary:** Extract tabular PDF contents into clean CSV spreadsheets.
- **Capabilities:** Extracts line/column data from PDF documents into RFC-compliant `.csv` files with preview and instant download.

### 4. PDF to HTML
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/pdf/pdf-to-html.html`
- **Category:** PDF Conversion & Utilities
- **Summary:** Convert PDFs to clean HTML code preserving text and formatting.
- **Capabilities:** Transforms PDF pages into structured semantic HTML markup ready to copy or download as `.html`.

### 5. PDF to Text
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/pdf/pdf-to-text.html`
- **Category:** PDF Conversion & Utilities
- **Summary:** Extract raw text from PDF documents with instant copy & download.
- **Capabilities:** Reads all pages of a PDF locally, extracts plain text with page markers, and exports `.txt` or copies to clipboard.

### 6. PDF to JPG
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/pdf/pdf-to-jpg.html`
- **Category:** PDF Conversion & Utilities
- **Summary:** Render and export PDF pages as high-quality JPG images.
- **Capabilities:** Renders PDF pages on HTML5 Canvas with selectable scale (1x, 1.5x, 2x) and JPG quality slider; downloads single pages or all pages as a `.zip` archive via JSZip.

### 7. PDF to PNG
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/pdf/pdf-to-png.html`
- **Category:** PDF Conversion & Utilities
- **Summary:** Convert PDF pages to lossless PNG images with transparent support.
- **Capabilities:** High-DPI canvas rendering of PDF pages into crisp `.png` images with per-page preview and batch ZIP export.

### 8. PDF to WebP
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/pdf/pdf-to-webp.html`
- **Category:** PDF Conversion & Utilities
- **Summary:** Convert PDF pages into lightweight, modern WebP images.
- **Capabilities:** Exports rendered PDF pages in compressed `.webp` format with scale/quality controls and ZIP batch download.

### 9. PDF to XML
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/pdf/pdf-to-xml.html`
- **Category:** PDF Conversion & Utilities
- **Summary:** Parse and structure PDF text into formatted XML hierarchy.
- **Capabilities:** Extracts per-page PDF text into valid, escaped XML nodes (`<document><page>`) with copy and `.xml` file download.

### 10. PDF to JSON
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/pdf/pdf-to-json.html`
- **Category:** PDF Conversion & Utilities
- **Summary:** Extract PDF text and page metadata into structured JSON.
- **Capabilities:** Outputs structured JSON containing filename, page count, and per-page text arrays for developer pipelines.

### 11. PDF to ZIP

- **Category:** PDF Conversion & Utilities
- **Summary:** Package and compress PDF documents into secure ZIP archives.

### 12. Merge PDF

- **Category:** PDF Conversion & Utilities
- **Summary:** Combine multiple PDF files into a single unified document.

### 13. PDF Splitter

## Category 2: Image Editing & Optimization (6 Tools)

All image tools process pixels locally via HTML5 Canvas (`canvas.toBlob` / `canvas.toDataURL`) with zero server uploads.

### 25. Image Compressor
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/images/image-compressor.html`
- **Category:** Image Editing & Optimization
- **Summary:** Reduce image file size with zero quality loss using HTML5 Canvas.
- **Capabilities:** Adjustable quality slider, live original vs. compressed size comparison, savings percentage, and instant download.

### 26. Image Resizer
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/images/image-resizer.html`
- **Category:** Image Editing & Optimization
- **Summary:** Resize images by width, height, or aspect ratio with instant preview.
- **Capabilities:** Pixel dimension inputs, aspect-ratio lock toggle, output format selection, and live canvas preview.

### 27. Compress to 100KB
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/images/image-100kb.html`
- **Category:** Image Editing & Optimization
- **Summary:** Optimize photos to strictly under 100KB for portals & forms.
- **Capabilities:** Iteratively tunes compression quality/dimensions in browser memory until the output image fits below the 100KB threshold.

### 28. Image Watermark Adder
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/images/image-watermark.html`
- **Category:** Image Editing & Optimization
- **Summary:** Add repeated or positioned text watermarks over images.
- **Capabilities:** Customize watermark text, font size, opacity, color, rotation/position, and export cleanly from HTML5 Canvas.

### 29. JPG to PNG Converter
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/images/jpg-to-png.html`
- **Category:** Image Editing & Optimization
- **Summary:** Convert JPG photos to PNG format with lossless compression.
- **Capabilities:** Instant client-side JPEG-to-PNG transcoding via Canvas with preview and download.

### 30. PNG to JPG Converter
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/images/png-to-jpg.html`
- **Category:** Image Editing & Optimization
- **Summary:** Convert transparent PNG files into high-speed JPG format.
- **Capabilities:** Fills transparency with configurable background color (e.g., white), adjusts JPG quality, and downloads `.jpg`.

### 40. Robots.txt Generator

- **Category:** SEO & Web Performance
- **Summary:** Configure crawl permissions and bot rules with visual controls.
- **Capabilities:** Builds compliant `robots.txt` files with user-agent rules, Allow/Disallow paths, crawl-delay, and Sitemap directives.

### 41. XML Sitemap Generator
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/seo/xml-sitemap-generator.html`
- **Category:** SEO & Web Performance
- **Summary:** Crawl internal links and generate search engine XML sitemaps.
- **Capabilities:** Discovers URLs or accepts URL lists and outputs valid `sitemap.xml` with `lastmod`, `changefreq`, and `priority`.

### 42. Website Speed Test
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/seo/website-speed-test.html`
- **Category:** SEO & Web Performance
- **Summary:** Benchmark page load metrics, Core Web Vitals, and DNS timing.
- **Capabilities:** Analyzes TTFB, Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP/FCP), and page asset weight diagnostics.

### 43. Keyword Density Checker
- **URL:** `https://YOUR_DOMAIN.com/tools/seo/keyword-density.html`
- **Category:** SEO & Web Performance
- **Summary:** Analyze word frequency and keyword optimization percentages in text.
- **Capabilities:** Computes 1-word, 2-word, and 3-word phrase frequency, stop-word filtering, and density percentages locally.
